# Attack Explorer

> Visual Cyber Attack, Log & Malware Analyzer mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

Attack Explorer is an interactive step-by-step visual simulator and analyzer for cyber attacks, SIEM/Sysmon log analysis, and malware behavioral execution mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Matrix (188 documented scenarios across 13 specialized categories, including 25 Cloud & SaaS scenarios, 13 Docker/Container/Kubernetes scenarios, and expanded ICS/OT, Mobile/Telecom, Database, AI/MLOps, and Zero-Day Appliance coverage).

## Core Capabilities
- **Attack Simulation:** Step-by-step visual execution of real-world adversary scenarios across Workstation, Domain Controller, and Cloud environments.
- **Log Forensics:** Live Sysmon, Windows Event Log, Linux auditd, and SIEM packet breakdown with correlated Sigma/YARA/KQL detection rules.
- **Behavioral Mapping:** Direct mapping to MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques (TTPs).
- **Process Memory Inspection:** Process hollowing, VAD memory forensics, CLR Profiler hijacking, and AMSI bypass flowcharts.

## Featured & Newly Added Scenarios (Cloud & SaaS, Docker/Containers, ICS/OT, Mobile/5G, Database, AI/MLOps & Zero-Day Appliances)
- [Process Hollowing (T1055.012)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/process-hollowing): `svchost.exe` suspension, section unmapping (`NtUnmapViewOfSection`), and memory injection.
- [PikeRed — Abusing the .NET CLR Profiler: Trusted-Binary Loader Chain (T1574.012)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/pikered-clr-profiler-trusted-binary-loader-chain): `.vhdx` MotW bypass, `+h +s` super-hidden files, and `COR_ENABLE_PROFILING=1` / `COR_PROFILER_PATH` hijacking of signed `KeePass.exe` ([PikeRed Research](https://www.pikered.com/en/learn/abusing-the-clr-profiler-a-trusted-binary-loader-chain-for-initial-access/)).
- [Jeffrey Appel — ARTEX Multi-Agent LLM Framework: Machine-Speed Attacks & Microsoft Defender XDR Disruption (T1110.003)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/jeffreyappel-artex-llm-multi-agent-machine-speed-defender-xdr): Go + Next.js Planner-Worker LLM agents chaining `Storm-0940` password spraying, web shells, `RC4` Kerberoasting, and 5-minute Azure Key Vault exfiltration countered by Defender XDR Automatic Attack Disruption and KQL multi-alert burst correlation ([Jeffrey Appel Research](https://jeffreyappel.nl/artex-old-attacks-at-machine-speed-and-how-microsoft-defender-keeps-up/)).
- [Dragos FrostyGoop — Industrial ENCO Controller Modbus TCP Port 502 Register Audit (T1190)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/ics-frostygoop-modbus-tcp-district-heating-controller-audit): Modbus TCP port 502 Function Code `0x03`/`0x06`/`0x10` district heating register manipulation and Zeek ICS telemetry.
- [Citizen Lab FORCEDENTRY & Google Project Zero — iOS JBIG2 Stream & MVT DataUsage Forensics (CVE-2021-30860)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/mobile-pegasus-forcedentry-imessage-jbigh2-blastdoor-forensics): Zero-click iMessage PDF/JBIG2 `CoreGraphics` logic circuit emulation and `DataUsage.sqlite` / `IMTransferAgent` forensics.
- [Mandiant & Snowflake UNC5537 — Single-Factor Session & QUERY_HISTORY Egress Forensics (T1078.004)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/db-snowflake-unc5537-single-factor-auth-data-egress-audit): `ACCOUNT_USAGE.LOGIN_HISTORY` single-factor sessions and `COPY INTO @~` stage exfiltration.
- [MLflow Tracking Server URI Fragment Path Traversal & Artifact Store Audit (CVE-2024-2928)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/ai-mlflow-unauthenticated-tracking-server-artifact-lfi-cve-2024-2928): `artifact_location` URI fragment differential and `/model-versions/get-artifact` file read.
- [Black Lotus Labs Volt Typhoon — Versa Director SD-WAN Port 4566 Favicon Upload & VersaMem Java Agent Audit (CVE-2024-39717)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/versa-director-sdwan-guiclient-jar-upload-cve-2024-39717-audit): Port 4566 `change_Dynamic_Favicon` `.png`-disguised JAR upload and Tomcat JVM `ApplicationFilterChain` instrumentation.
- [Midnight Blizzard (APT29) — Entra ID Legacy OAuth App Compromise & Exchange full_access_as_app Role Audit (CISA ED 24-02)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/cloud-midnight-blizzard-oauth-legacy-test-app-audit): Legacy OAuth app password spray, Service Principal credential injection, and `full_access_as_app` Exchange Graph EWS audit.
- [AWS IAM & STS — GetFederationToken Console Sign-In Token Minting & MFA Bypass Audit (T1550.001)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/cloud-aws-sts-federation-token-console-signin-audit): `sts:GetFederationToken` to `signin.aws.amazon.com/federation` console session minting with `MFAUsed: "No"`.
- [AWS S3 & KMS — Cross-Account KMS Key Re-Encryption & S3 Object Lifecycle Extortion Audit (T1486)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/cloud-aws-s3-kms-external-account-encryption-extortion-audit): In-place `CopyObject` re-encryption with external KMS Customer Managed Keys and 1-day `PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration` purge.
- [GitHub Actions & Cloud OIDC — pull_request_target Untrusted Checkout & Federated Role Token Audit (T1195.002)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/cloud-github-actions-pull-request-target-oidc-token-audit): `pull_request_target` untrusted fork checkout and `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` OIDC token exchange.
- [Docker Engine — Unauthenticated TCP Port 2375 REST API Exposure & Host File System Bind Mount Audit (T1610)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/docker-engine-unauthenticated-tcp-2375-api-socket-audit): Unauthenticated Docker REST API `POST /v1.43/containers/create` with `Privileged:true` and `Binds:["/:/hostfs:rw"]`.
- [Docker BuildKit & runc — Cache Mount Race & WORKDIR File Descriptor Leak Audit (CVE-2024-23651 & CVE-2024-21626)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/docker-buildkit-runc-cache-mount-race-cve-2024-23651): Leaky Vessels `RUN --mount=type=cache` symlink race (`CVE-2024-23651`) and `runc` `/proc/self/fd` leak (`CVE-2024-21626`).
- [Linux Containers — CAP_SYS_ADMIN Cgroup v1 notify_on_release & release_agent Host Execution Audit (T1611)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/container-cap-sys-admin-cgroup-release-agent-notify-audit): Over-privileged container `CAP_SYS_ADMIN` cgroup v1 `release_agent` execution via `overlayfs` `upperdir`.
- [Kubernetes Admission Control — MutatingWebhookConfiguration Registration & Pod Sidecar Injection Audit (T1546)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/k8s-mutating-admission-webhook-sidecar-injection-audit): Cluster-wide `MutatingWebhookConfiguration` intercepting `pods/CREATE` to inject JSONPatch sidecar containers.
- [ALPHV / BlackCat (Sphynx Rust) Ransomware (CISA AA23-353A)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/alphv-blackcat-sphynx-rust-impacket-exmatter): `--access-token` SHA-256 gate, ExMatter exfiltration, and `fsutil` symlink encryption.
- [Royal & BlackSuit Ransomware (CISA AA23-061A / AA24-219A)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/royal-blacksuit-ransomware-chacha20-restartmanager): Windows Restart Manager (`RstrtMgr.dll`) handle unlocking and partial-stripe encryption.
- [RansomHub Ransomware (CISA AA24-242A)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/ransomhub-edrkiller-tdsskiller-golocks): `EDRKillShifter` / `TDSSKiller.exe` BYOVD kernel termination and `-pass` SHA-256 config decryption.
- [Medusa Ransomware (CISA AA25-071A)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/medusa-ransomware-gaze-abyss-pdqdeploy): PDQ Deploy & SimpleHelp RMM fleet push and `gaze.exe` `.medusa` encryption.
- [Qilin (Agenda) Rust Ransomware](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/qilin-agenda-rust-chrome-cred-harvester-esxi): SYSVOL GPO Chrome DPAPI credential harvester and ESXi `vim-cmd` encryption.
- [Hunters International Ransomware (Hive Rust Lineage)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/hunters-international-hive-rust-wsus-sharpwmi): WSUS & SharpWMI deployment and `wbadmin` catalog wipe.
- [INC Ransom & Lynx Ransomware](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/inc-ransom-lynx-citrix-netscaler-wmic-mega): Citrix NetScaler initial access, `WMIC /node:@targets.txt` propagation, and `PrintBombing`.
- [Cactus Ransomware](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/cactus-ransomware-qlik-sense-ssh-batch-unpacker): Qlik Sense `CVE-2023-41265` exploitation and self-decrypting `-i <HexKey>` payload execution.
- [8Base & Phobos Ransomware (CISA AA24-045A)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/eightbase-phobos-smoke-loader-process-hacker): SmokeLoader delivery into `explorer.exe` and `.eight8` encryption.
- [Cl0p Ransomware Full Intrusion Chain (CISA AA23-158A)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/cl0p-truebot-flawedgrace-sdbbot-ransomware): `TrueBot` -> `FlawedGrace` / `SDBbot` -> Cl0p 660+ process/service killer.
- [@solana/web3.js & @rspack/core npm Supply-Chain Compromise (Dec 2024)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/rspack-solana-web3js-npm-supply-chain-2024): `addToQueue` Ed25519 private key exfiltration and `postinstall` CI token theft.
- [@lottiefiles/lottie-player npm & CDN Supply-Chain Attack (Oct 2024)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/lottie-player-npm-ace-supply-chain-2024): Unpinned `unpkg`/`jsDelivr` CDN Ace Drainer modal injection.
- [CircleCI OAuth & CI/CD Secret Store Supply-Chain Breach](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/circleci-oauth-github-token-rotation-breach): Engineer laptop infostealer -> 2FA SSO session hijack -> customer GitHub/AWS token theft.
- [JetBrains TeamCity CVE-2024-27198 CI/CD Supply-Chain Build Poisoning](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/jetbrains-teamcity-cve-2024-27198-supply-chain-build-poisoning): `;jsp=.jsp` auth bypass, `SYSTEM_ADMIN` token minting, and release runner injection.
- [PyTorch-Nightly torchtriton PyPI Dependency Confusion](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/pypi-pytorch-torchtriton-dependency-confusion-supply-chain): Public PyPI namespace shadowing and chunked DNS exfiltration (`*.h4ck.cfd`).
